issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md shows the Animal constructor with a '-' visibility (private) while the intended/solution implementation uses a public constructor. A private constructor in the UML would contradict the need for subclasses (Pig, Goat, Seal) to call super(...) and would confuse students about the correct visibility to use for Animal(String).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML and problem statement to indicate that the Animal(String) constructor should be public (change '-' to '+'), or explicitly state in the text that the constructor must be public so subclasses can call super(name). This aligns the specification with the provided solution and avoids student confusion.
